title: JobHunterKit
description: One application kit for a job that was chosen for pursuit: fit summary, cover note, ATS answers and questions for the first call.

job_id.description: The job id from the input, copied unchanged.

language.description: Language of every text field in this object.

fit_summary.description: Exactly three bullets, one sentence each, factual, drawn from the profile and the resume only.

items.description: One factual bullet, no adjectives without a fact behind them.

cover_note.description: Four to eight sentences in my voice: direct, concrete, numbers where they are honest, calm and choosy. No compensation figure, no start date, no notice period. No exclamation marks, no chains of em dashes, no triads, no negative parallelisms.

ats_answers.description: The standard application questions with my answers, in the order given in kit.md. A line that carries a figure, a date or a notice period carries a [CONFIRM] marker on the same line.

question.description: The application question as the form asks it.

answer.description: My answer, in my voice, paste-ready.

call_questions.description: Three to five questions for the first call, taken from questions.md, the ones that resolve blocking unknowns first.
